name: Bamboo desk organiser, 3 compartments (pen / mobile / cards), office and corporate gifting
supplier_cost_note: IndiaMART listing 'Bamboo Desk Organiser - Stylish, Functional & Eco-Friendly' Rs 199/piece, 3 compartments, seller Greeniecan India, New Delhi; seen 2026-11-12 via WebSearch snippet of https://m.indiamart.com/impcat/desk-organizer.html (page not fetchable). MOQ not captured. Assumed excl. GST. Other bamboo listings in the same results: De Corpoholix bamboo mobile-pen stand sets Rs 97-180/piece; Akinitos (Chennai) bamboo card holder with double pen holder Rs 115/piece.
retail_observed: PARTIAL: Apkamart 'Wooden Pen Mobile & Card Holder 3 Compartments - 7 Inch' Rs 699 sale (MRP shown Rs 2,500), wooden not bamboo; indiahandmade.com bamboo pen holder (single compartment) Rs 450 special price (Rs 500 regular), out of stock; Gurez Woodkey 3-in-1 engineered-wood organiser Rs 449 MRP. All seen 2026-11-12 via WebSearch snippets. No exact bamboo 3-compartment retail price found.

demand_signals.summary: Several B2B sellers (Pune, Delhi, Chennai) market bamboo/wood pen stands specifically for corporate gifting; supply-side signal only.
3-compartment pen/mobile/card holder sold at Rs 699; retail price anchor, no sales data.

risks: Out-of-Odisha supplier (New Delhi): website-only per docs/05
Margin depends on Rs 699 holding; cheapest comparables retail at Rs 449, so price may need to fall (which would breach the ~29% cost ratio)
Bamboo can mould/crack in humid storage; check finish and packaging
'Eco-friendly' claim should be worded carefully; no certification seen
GST rate for bamboo articles (HSN 4602/4421) to be confirmed by CA; 12% is an estimate

review.notes: Competitors sell the same 3-way pen/visiting-card/mobile holder far cheaper: Rs 149 on Meesho (BMB Shoppe, about 4.2 stars from 400+ ratings) and Rs 213 for the Gurez Woodkey 3-in-1 (now down from the Rs 449 the researcher saw); the only Rs 699 anchor is a wooden Apkamart listing with an inflated Rs 2,500 MRP. The margin needs about Rs 670 or more (Rs 599 gives 23.2%, Rs 449 is loss-making), so no realistic price meets the 30% target.
